description: This file defines the 'Registry' class within the Opencart System Engine namespace, implementing a registry pattern for managing objects via key-value storage with magic methods for property overloading.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: Implements a registry pattern to store and retrieve objects using magic methods and explicit accessors.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to retrieve an object by key from the registry.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set an object in the registry by key.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check if a key exists in the registry.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve an object associated with the key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Store an object with the associated key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Check if a key exists in the registry.

methods.name: unset
methods.description: Remove an object from the registry by key.
